synth.final_message:
19 of 20 transitions pass. I stopped there because the last failure cannot be explained from the recorded data.

| Action | Effect implemented in `program.py` |
|---|---|
| 3 | Cursor moves to the previous editable glyph column. It wraps from the first column to the last. |
| 4 | Cursor moves to the next editable glyph column. It wraps from the last column to the first. |
| 1, 2 | No change to any recorded field. The states have no `pixels` field, so any change these actions make to the glyphs is not visible. |

**Failure that remains:** at step 20, action 2 moved `legend_cyan_0` from x=13 to x=14. At step 1, action 2 changed nothing. The only visible difference between the two steps is the cursor position (column 0 at step 1, column 1 at step 20). One case is not sufficient to find a rule. More likely, the cause is a hidden state that the 12 + 3 earlier presses of action 1 changed. A rule fitted to this one transition would be a guess, so I did not add one. The header comment in `program.py` records this as an unconfirmed hypothesis.

To resolve it, I would need more observations: action 2 at other cursor positions and after different numbers of action 1 presses, or states that include glyph pixels.
